name: Discworld MUD lib (v1)
english_description: The earliest of three Cratylus Discworld FluffOS-bundle snapshots in this collection (bundled fluffos-1.22c11 driver ignored). Same official Discworld mudlib as libs/discworld (v3), converted independently from dw_fluffos_v1/lib/ and given the same mechanical FluffOS-compat fixes (virtual.h self-include, add_method("lpc"), .ob #Class suffixes, command.lpc [0..<5], add_action catch-all "*" -> ""). Port 40271.
